headline: 10-year Treasury yield jumps back above 5% as oil gains and more Fed rate hikes expected
detail: Higher yields make future tech earnings less attractive and increase borrowing costs, directly pressuring your concentrated tech/chip portfolio, especially those on margin. This is a significant headwind for your holdings.
rec: Consider trimming some of your leveraged tech/chip ETFs like SMH or SOXL to reduce exposure to interest rate sensitivity.

headline: Jensen Huang built Nvidia into a behemoth. His resignation puts the entire AI boom in jeopardy.
detail: This headline, if accurate, signals a massive leadership change at Nvidia, a key player in your tech/chip heavy portfolio. Such a departure would likely cause significant market instability and a broad sell-off in the AI and semiconductor sectors.
rec: Avoid any new tech/chip buys and strongly consider reducing exposure to existing leveraged tech/chip holdings to mitigate potential sector-wide downside.

headline: Lutnick should ban Chinese memory maker CXMT from U.S., Sen. Cotton says
detail: Potential U.S. bans on Chinese memory makers could impact global chip supply chains. While it might protect U.S. chip companies, it also introduces trade uncertainty for the sector.
rec: No immediate action is warranted, but monitor for further developments on trade restrictions that could affect your chip holdings.
